evidence.observation: The plan defines the completion surface: 'The milestone is complete when, on main after merge:' — every predicate's evidence must hold on GND main after the topic branch merges.

The candidate states the gates 'are complete on the GND topic branch in draft PR #160', that 'The r3 requirement to verify closure on GND main remains pending', and 'The close panel and GND merge are pending.'

'The milestone close ruling governs adoption of this amendment.' — adoption is bound to a ruling taken while the plan's own 'on main after merge' condition is still unverified, and no carryover or condition records the pending post-merge verification.

concerns.recommendation: Record the post-merge verification on GND main as an explicit condition of the close ruling (or as a named carryover in the close record), so adopting the amendment cannot close the milestone before the plan's stated completion surface is checked; alternatively defer the ruling until PR #160 merges and main is verified.
concerns.title: Close ruling requested before the plan's 'on main after merge' completion surface is verified

response.summary: All three artifacts hash-match. Every r3 exit predicate is accounted for with traceable evidence, refuted premises (predicate 1 census scope, predicate 6 universal conversion) are explicitly recorded in the close amendment, numeric claims are internally consistent (41 roster = 38 admitted + 3 include refusals; 30+8 = 38 round trips; 34 GND-diff + 4 authored-document = 38; 36 conversions + 2 refusals = 38; 29 corpus controls match the amendment), and the open-question sweep verifiably covers the open questions recorded in the OS0, OS1 and OS4 phase records plus the OS6 source-emission carryover. One blocking gap: the plan defines completion as holding 'on main after merge', and the candidate itself states the main verification and GND merge remain pending, yet neither artifact records the post-merge verification as an explicit condition of the close ruling.
